integrity: Formal proof with two independently executed finite checkers; empirical checks corroborate but do not establish the unbounded theorem.
scientific_limitations: Cyclic dihedral quandles over finite prime-power rings; the unweighted determinant-zero all-arity count is published prior work and excluded from novelty; no general Alexander-quandle extension or independent priority proof.
title: Joint image and product ranks of commuting endomorphisms of finite dihedral quandles
